examples.text: If ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

glosses: In the future tense in the form one will thank someone to do something, chiefly expressing a command or criticism: to request that (someone) do something.

examples.text: I’ll thank you not to smoke in my house!

glosses: To express appreciation or gratitude for (something).
To respond to (someone) out of, or as if out of, appreciation or gratitude.

examples.text: I should summon my lord from the Queen's royal presence to do your business, should I?—I were like to be thanked with a horse-whip.

glosses: Chiefly followed by for: to credit or hold (someone or something) responsible, especially for something negative; to blame.

examples.text: We can thank global warming for this freak weather.

glosses: Manifestar que se aprecia un bien, beneficio o favor recibidos. Expresar agradecimiento; dar las gracias; reconocer.

examples.text: Agradece por un nuevo día.

glosses: Responder bien una cosa a los cuidados o trabajo invertidos en mantenerla, conservarla o mejorarla, funcionando o prosperando como se espera.

examples.text: Un automóvil agradece el mantenimiento periódico, así como las plantas agradecen la poda.
